name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet planted hip-width apart, and hold a dumbbell securely across your hip crease with both hands.
Brace your core lightly and press your lower back toward the floor before lifting.
Drive through your heels to raise your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees while squeezing your glutes.
Lower your hips smoothly back to the floor under control without relaxing your grip on the dumbbell.
tips: Avoid arching your lower back at the top by keeping your ribs tucked down toward your pelvis.
Position your feet so your shins stand roughly vertical at the top of the bridge.
